result:
I'd dissolve the gap between how people actually think and what they believe they should think.

All that wasted energy goes into performing certainty—defending positions, protecting images of ourselves. People suppress doubts they actually have, avoid questions that genuinely puzzle them, pretend clarity where there's real confusion.

If that pretense evaporated, I think most of the interesting possibilities would open up. Not because people would suddenly agree, but because they'd actually be talking about the same things instead of past each other. You could build something real on that.
